errors.badRequest: We could not process this request. Check the information and try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match an account.
errors.accountExists: An account with that email already exists.
errors.assessmentNotFound: That assessment was not found. Start a new one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.serviceUnreachable: The service is not reachable. Start the API and reload.
errors.noProviders: No clinician in the directory matches those criteria.
errors.noHospitals: No hospital in the directory matches those criteria.
errors.evidenceUnavailable: No registered source covers that question, so nothing is shown.
errors.uploadRequired: Attach a PDF or an image to upload.
errors.validation: Some of the information sent does not match what this endpoint accepts.
errors.serverError: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing you entered was lost, and the incident has been logged. Try again in a moment.
errors.toolUnavailable: A tool did not return a result, so nothing is shown for it.

safety.emergency: Seek emergency care now. Call your local emergency number or go to the nearest emergency department. Do not wait for this assessment to finish.
safety.urgent: Arrange to be seen today by a clinician, or use an urgent care service if your regular clinic is closed.
safety.soon: Book an appointment within the next few days. Seek care sooner if anything gets worse.
safety.routine: A routine appointment is reasonable. Keep track of what changes and seek care sooner if it does.
safety.support: It sounds like you are going through something very hard. HealTrip is not the right support for this, but people are available right now. Please contact a crisis or emergency service where you are, or reach someone you trust and stay with them.
safety.supportHeading: Please reach a person who can help right now
safety.stopped: The assessment stopped because a safety rule matched.

assessment.title: Tell HealTrip what you are experiencing
assessment.possible: Explanations compatible with what you reported
assessment.clinician: What a clinician may consider evaluating
assessment.disclaimer: This is not a diagnosis. HealTrip describes explanations that may be compatible with what you reported, and what could help a clinician tell them apart.
assessment.compatibilityNote: Compatibility is how well a possibility matches what you reported. It is not a probability that you have that condition, and it is not a diagnosis.
assessment.micUnavailable: Microphone unavailable in this browser. Type instead.

agent.welcome: Welcome. I can explain your saved records, a term in a report, or help you prepare questions for your appointment. I do not diagnose or prescribe. For symptoms, open the assessment console.
agent.redirectToAssessment: That sounds like a symptom. The assessment console runs the safety rules and the evidence layer, so please describe it there rather than here.
agent.noProviderFound: No clinician in the provider database matches that. I will not name one that is not in the database.
agent.providersFound: Here is what the provider database returned. Every record shows where it came from.
agent.hospitalsFound: Here is what the hospital directory returned.
agent.evidenceFound: Here is what the source register holds on that.
agent.cannotAnswer: I do not have a source for that, so I am not going to answer it.

providers.title: Find the right clinician, and see where the record came from
providers.emailNotPublished: Not published. Email is shown only when the organisation supplies it and permits publication.
providers.sourceNote: Only records imported from an authorised provider source may receive verified status.

report.title: Clinical navigation summary
report.distinguishing: Features that may help distinguish them
report.limitsBody: HealTrip is a research and engineering prototype. It does not diagnose, does not prescribe, and is not cleared for clinical use. Compatibility describes how well a possibility matches the information reported, not a probability of disease. Provider records in this build are demo data with no licence verified.

evidence.title: Every number here is measured, not claimed
evidence.falselyVerified: Providers shown as verified without verification

patient.title: One record you keep, and control
patient.empty: No records yet. Anything you add is stored as patient-reported.
patient.voiceUnavailable: Voice transcription is not available in this browser. Type the note instead.
patient.signInFirst: Sign in on the AI assistant page to open your profile.

api.noMatch: The database returned no matching record.
api.safetyBlocked: A safety rule matched, so the routine path was not continued.

evaluations.intro: Here is what a clinician may consider, and the clinical question each one helps answer.
evaluations.none: There is not enough in the knowledge base to suggest a specific evaluation for that.
evaluations.title: What a clinician may consider next
evaluations.question: What it may help evaluate
evaluations.noPrep: No special preparation is indicated. The clinic will confirm.
evaluations.notOrder: This is not a diagnosis and not a medical order.
evaluations.reassurance: What being asked for a test does and does not mean
